score: 250/250 replayed; database rows -69% dev, -58% held out
metric: Failing (original, mutant) pairs reduced in query, schema and database while they still differ, then replayed from JSON on a fresh engine; dev 692 to 216 rows, held out 595 to 250; SQL nodes -27% dev, -50% held out.
correctness: Each reduced case replays as different on a fresh engine (250/250). It is not an equivalence-preserving simplification: the reduced queries differ from the originals and only the failure is preserved.
held_out: 100 held-out cases: 100/100 replayed, median 2 rows left
caveats: 150 dev and 100 held-out killed mutants sampled evenly. Median 0.14 s dev and 0.45 s held out per case (max 4.6 s); median rows left 1 dev, 2 held out. Edits are made on both queries at once, so the part that differs is kept.
